parties.respondent: The Tamil Nadu Electricity Board And Anr.

summary: Dispute over electricity demand reduction; contracted load vs actual consumption; delay in processing 10000 KVA request; refund claim for excess payments made between 2001-2004; interpretation of 1999 Agreement clauses 6,7,11,22.07; writ jurisdiction barred for contractual disputes; Board's procedural delays deemed unreasonable; High Court error in refusing refund for unjust enrichment.
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; High Court judgment set aside; refund granted for excess payments made during delayed processing period 2002-2004; revised demand charges to be applied prospectively.
